name: MonarchDeltaIndicator
title: DeltaIndicator
wrapsNative: HStack of an SF Symbol (MonarchIcon) and Text
summary: A change between two periods: an arrow, a signed value and an optional comparison, such as "+12% vs last month". The colour follows which direction is better.
whenToUse: Beside a metric, in a stat card or a table cell, to show how it moved.
whenNotToUse: For a status that is not a change, use MonarchBadge. For the trend itself, use MonarchSparkline, and put this beside it.
api: MonarchDeltaIndicator.init(_ value: Double?, comparison: String? = nil, goodDirection: MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection = .up, variant: MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant = .plain, size: MonarchDeltaIndicatorSize = .sm, flatThreshold: Double = 0, flatLabel: String? = nil, noDataLabel: String? = nil, spokenLabel: String? = nil, showsIcon: Bool = true, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = nil)

MonarchDeltaIndicator.init(current: Double?, previous: Double?, comparison: String? = nil, goodDirection: MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection = .up, variant: MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant = .plain, size: MonarchDeltaIndicatorSize = .sm, flatThreshold: Double = 0, flatLabel: String? = nil, noDataLabel: String? = nil, spokenLabel: String? = nil, showsIcon: Bool = true, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = nil)

options.name: value
options.description: The change. A ratio (0.12 is 12%) unless formatValue writes it another way. nil means there is nothing to compare with.

options.name: current, previous
options.description: In the second initialiser: the two periods. The change is (current − previous) / |previous|.

options.name: comparison
options.description: The comparison period after the change, such as "vs last month".

options.name: goodDirection
options.description: up, down or neither: which direction is an improvement.

options.name: variant
options.description: plain is inline text; subtle is a tinted pill.

options.name: size
options.description: sm is caption size, md is label size.

options.name: flatThreshold
options.description: Changes whose size is at or below this count as no change.

options.name: noDataLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in text "No earlier data".

options.name: spokenLabel
options.description: Replaces the whole sentence VoiceOver reads.

options.name: showsIcon
options.description: Shows the arrow. The sign and the spoken direction remain without it.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes the size of the change, without a sign. The default is a percentage in the current locale.

states.name: better
states.description: A change in the good direction: the success colour, an arrow and a sign.

states.name: worse
states.description: A change in the other direction: the danger colour, an arrow and a sign.

states.name: neutral
states.description: goodDirection is neither: muted text, an arrow and a sign.

states.name: no change
states.description: Zero, inside flatThreshold, or written the same as zero: a dash symbol and "No change".

states.name: no data
states.description: nil or not finite: "No earlier data", with no arrow and no comparison.

appearance: Plain is coloured text: the success strong, danger strong or muted text colour. The pill adds the matching subtle fill. The comparison is muted text, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web formats percentages, numbers with a unit and currencies from options; here the default is a percentage and formatValue takes a closure for anything else. The web appearance values plain and pill are the variants plain and subtle. The web lets each spoken word (up, down, better, worse) be replaced; here those four come from the strings table and spokenLabel replaces the whole sentence. The current and previous initialiser always gives a ratio; for an absolute difference, subtract and pass the value. The arrows point up-right and down-right in both layout directions. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The indicator is one element that reads a sentence: "up 12% vs last month, better".
The direction is carried by the arrow, the sign and the spoken words; better and worse are spoken, so nothing depends on colour.
A decrease is written with a real minus sign (U+2212).
The arrow is decorative and hidden from VoiceOver.
Text scales with Dynamic Type; digits are monospaced so values line up in a column.
edgeCases: A change that the format writes as zero, such as 0.0001 as a percentage, is "No change", never "+0%".
With current and previous, a previous value of zero has no baseline and shows "No earlier data".
A negative baseline uses its absolute value, so −100 to −50 is an increase of 50%.
The comparison is not shown when there is no data.
